variance: mean of unbiased per-pixel luminance sample variances

tail.positive_residual: replicate minus same-backend leave-one-out pixel mean
tail.metric: sum largest positive squared residuals divided by all region pixels, averaged over replicates

bootstrap.bounds: one-sided simultaneous maximum-centered log-ratio bootstrap error across all 48 primary statistics

epsilon: 1e-12 * max(1, mean_pixel(square(reference ensemble mean luminance))) per scene, plane, region
near_zero_gate: when reference energy<=epsilon require candidate upper energy<=1.25*epsilon; report absolute gate, not variance ratio
mean_gate: unclamped RGB regional means: 5 combined standard errors + 2e-5 * max(1,abs(reference))
failure_policy: Missing, duplicate, malformed, mixed-model/contract or inconclusive records fail admission. No dropped IDs, optional stopping, post-outcome extensions or fabricated historical64baseline.
overrides: statistical variants change resolution,spp,sampler/material seeds and FLOAT storage; PBRT raw companion changes only Film clamping and stores unexposed values after known ISO conversion; all world,camera,filter,and original exposure settings retained
material_seed: corresponding sampler seed for each arm; explicit authored sampler seed and material/hash seed must match the frozen ID

reference_policy.description: Root must freeze exact consistent target model, modifications, source and artifact identity before outcomes. This is not stock PBRT ground truth.

quality_budgets: primary_spp only;64spp remains a separately labeled timing/preview budget and cannot substitute for endpoints
selection_limit: Root owns final64unused IDs per arm and reference model. Null draft fields forbid renderer/acceptor execution. Prior observed-ID ledger and model-review receipt must be bound before freeze.
